packages.description: Analytics and CSV export engine for kasir.mu — daily summaries, sales reports, inventory movement.

packages.name: kasirmu-cli
packages.description: Command-line tools for kasir.mu — migrations, backup, export, smoke tests.

packages.description: Structured logging facade for kasir.mu — context-tagged log records, file + stdout output, log rotation, syslog, Event Log.

packages.description: Image processing for kasir.mu — thumbnails, compression, auto-crop. PLANNED (stubs).

packages.description: WhatsApp Cloud API notification client for kasir.mu — template messaging, media support, webhook verification, and mock driver for testing.

packages.description: Payment processor abstraction for kasir.mu — Stripe, Square, EMV terminals behind a single trait.
